scope: HBQ traffic hold intent compared with native convoy endpoint admission

reference.limitations: Selected branches only, not whole-function or whole-HBQ review.

findings: HBQ standalone explicitly disables convoy handling; it cannot establish convoy pacing parity.
Traffic stopping hysteresis separates hold state and physical collision room. Unsafe ignore/push/relocation methods remain outside this implementation.

CBE already has continuous spacing and smoothing. Native endpoint refresh comment allowed stopped legs conceptually, but actual predicate required over8m endpoint advance even after physical endpoint completion.

implementation.change: Finished native leg can accept over3m endpoint advance at rest within3m and1.5m vertical of exact previous endpoint; requires ready local operator, MOVE/idle command and unchanged seat/destination receipts. Moving legs retain8m threshold, all speed/safety caps remain unchanged.
implementation.provenance: Independent CBE execution repair; no raw upstream code/assets copied and no new HBQ convoy parity claim.

validation.retained_failure: .qa/cbe-convoy-native-endpoint-build.log: upstream comparison sentence placed in packaged guide; moved to engineering review without weakening boundary test.

remaining: Actual native readiness/expectedDestination semantics on endpoint completion.
Slow mixed tracked/wheeled step-off, stop/start, curves, bridges and explicit STOP/changed seat/destination physical cases.
Configured spacing and mass-adjusted braking are provisional, not measured guarantees.
Median/p95 performance budget and whole-HBQ parity remain unaccepted.
